# Coding Friend

> A lean, opinionated toolkit that makes your AI coding agent work like a disciplined engineer, adding skills, agents, and hooks to Claude Code, Codex, oh-my-pi, Antigravity, Devin CLI (beta), and other AI coding tools.

Coding Friend provides a systematic workflow of plan → implement → review → commit, with project knowledge stored in `docs/` and learning notes in `~/.coding-friend/learn/`. It includes a memory system, security hooks, and mechanisms to protect privacy while enhancing AI agent capabilities.

## Documentation

- [Main Documentation](https://cf.dinh.work): Complete guide to Coding Friend features, installation, and usage
- [Getting Started Guide](https://cf.dinh.work#-install): Installation instructions for all supported AI coding tools
- [Skills Reference](https://cf.dinh.work#-skills): Complete list of available `/cf-*` skills like plan, review, commit, fix
- [Agents Reference](https://cf.dinh.work#-agents): Subagents for exploration, implementation, planning, and code review
- [CLI Documentation](https://github.com/dinhanhthi/coding-friend/blob/main/cli/README.md): Command-line interface for memory, installation, and configuration

## Features

- [Architecture Overview](https://cf.dinh.work#how-coding-friend-works): System design and workflow diagrams
- [Memory System](https://cf.dinh.work#-memory): Three-tier search and knowledge management
- [Auto-approve](https://cf.dinh.work#-auto-approve): Smart automation with security controls
- [Security Pipeline](https://cf.dinh.work#-security): Prompt injection defense and content isolation
- [Cross-agent Review](https://cf.dinh.work#-review): Multi-AI code review capabilities

## Installation

- [NPM Package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/coding-friend-cli): Command-line interface installation
- [Claude Code Plugin](https://claude.com/marketplace): Direct installation in Claude Code
- [Supported Hosts](https://cf.dinh.work#-supported-tools): Compatibility matrix for AI coding tools
